mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 44 degrees. We have checked the latest city reports and emails, and there are no new developments or urgent items to report for the residents of Verona today.

It is a busy day in town. Today, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac, attend a yoga class at Insight Wellness, or enjoy pizza at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out trivia at The Mill or The Bogey Factory, and keep an eye out for Art House 360 events starting tomorrow night.
The Verona Police Department did not have any reports of criminal activity or noteworthy incidents to share from this past week.
Today's featured flavor at Culver's is the Chocolate Caramel Twist. The store is currently closed, but they will open today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and satisfy your sweet tooth.
